'''2006 Yavin IV Regional''' was a Star Wars CCG regional (1 April 2006). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Renaissance Games, 2315 A-6 Belair Road, Fallston, Maryland 21047 (the same store as in 2005)<ref name="pcf-9009-123768">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=123768#123768 The waiting is over.......Y4 Regional 2006 Info is here!], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 February 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095832/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9009&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-9009-129374">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=129374#129374 The waiting is over.......Y4 Regional 2006 Info is here!], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 March 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095728/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=129408&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 1 April 2006
* '''Players:''' 30<ref name="sf-14253-199507">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=199507#p199507 Yavin IV Regionals - March 31, 2007], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (26 February 2007).</ref>
* '''Start:''' 12 noon on Saturday 1 April 2006; registration from 11am<ref name="pcf-9009-123768" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Tim Simon]]<ref name="pcf-9009-123768" />
* '''Entry:''' $15; decklists required; clear sleeves not allowed<ref name="pcf-9009-123768" />
* '''Prizes:''' uncut sheets, boosters, tournament foils, cash (a guaranteed first prize of over $200), two byes to the [[2006 World Championship|2006 World Championships]] and a virtual card design for the winner<ref name="pcf-9009-123768" />

== Worlds qualifiers ==

The Players Committee's list of qualifiers for the [[2006 World Championship|2006 World Championships]] (3 April 2006) names [[Steven Lewis]] and [[Justin Stratton]] for the 2006 Yavin IV Regional.<ref name="pcf-9443-130633">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=130633#130633 Qualifiers for Worlds 2006], Michael Carr (mc9457), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618055549/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141112 Internet Archive]</ref>

In February 2007 [[Tim Simon]] recalled that the 2006 regional drew 30 players and was the first to be an international event, with visitors from the Hoth: Ice Plains region, and that [[Nick Reisch]] had a strong finish representing Texas. Team TN's [[Steven Lewis|Steve Lewis]] and [[Justin Stratton]] played "well enough to get ahead of the competition"; WYS (v) was "the deck du jour"; and the top four were Lewis, Stratton, [[Reid Smith]] and [[Michael Pistone|Mike Pistone]]. Five of the twelve players in Day 3 of the [[2006 World Championship]], including the world champion [[Nate Meeker]], had played at the regional.<ref name="sf-14253-199507" />
